question: Who took the oath as the new Chief Justice of the Bombay High Court on September 5, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Shree Chandrashekhar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Justice Shree Chandrashekhar was sworn in as the new Chief Justice of the Bombay High Court on September 5, 2025.**
 
• **The oath was administered by Maharashtra Governor C.P. Radhakrishnan at a ceremony at Raj Bhavan, Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The swearing-in ceremony was attended by CM Devendra Fadnavis, Legislative Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar, Mumbai Police Commissioner Deven Bharti, and DGP Rashmi Shukla.**
 
• **Justice Shree Chandrashekhar assumes office as the new Chief Justice of Bombay High Court, marking a significant milestone.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Swearing-in Ceremony**__

 __
 
• The ceremony was held at Raj Bhavan, Mumbai, with key political and law enforcement officials in attendance.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Appointment**__
 
 
• Justice Shree Chandrashekhar is expected to lead the Bombay High Court through important legal and judicial decisions.
